notes.title: Roadmap Update - 2025 and Beyond.
notes.content:
[p]Hello Spiritographers!

We released the All Aboard DLC a few weeks ago and have been thrilled with the response! [/p][p]Of course, the train keeps chugging along and we wanted to share a look at our upcoming plans. We're always careful to not over promise, so we usually only share features we're confident we can deliver.[/p][p]That said, here's a look at our roadmap for the rest of 2025![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43866816/d4c7e5800b52a0606eee85f238f8a1eee9e564e9.png"][/img][/p][h2]Sept 29th - Autumn Update[/h2][p]We’ve got a small update coming this Autumn! With the release of the [i]All Aboard![/i] DLC just behind us, we didn’t have much time to build a lot of new content, but we still wanted to join in on the Halloween season.[/p][list][*][p][b]Local Music Importer[/b][/p][list][*][p]You will soon be able to import MP3s, WAV or OGG files from your music library to play in game![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Productivity tool improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]To-do list improvements - Progress bar, "reset all" button, sorting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Halloween skins for Spirits[/b][/p][list][*][p]Look forward to a few special Halloween skins for some Spirits[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Color customization for Halloween items[/b][/p][list][*][p]We've updated many of last years Halloween items to now be color customizable! From the bat-themed bed sheets to witchy hats, you can now make them your own. Be sure to keep an eye out for a couple small surprises.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Activities[/b][/p][list][*][p]We're adding two new activities - Reading by the fireplace and painting at the desk.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Halloween Playlist[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new playlist from Lofi Girl featuring chilling tracks to get into the spooky mood.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h2]Nov 17th - Winter Update[/h2][list][*][p][b]General UI improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]An updated, more streamlined style for the UI[/p][/*][*][p]Reworking some of the buttons placement, in preparation for controller support[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Customizable Timer Sounds[/b][/p][list][*][p]Offering the option to customize the sounds of the timer from different sets of sounds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new Spirit to discover![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Dresses + new outfits[/b][/p][list][*][p]Dresses has been one of biggest requests, we're working on it! We hope to add a few longer dress options as well as more clothing options in general.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Train backgrounds in bedroom[/b][/p][list][*][p]We will be adding static, non-moving versions of the train backgrounds to the bedroom. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Avatar face update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Another popular request, we'll be adding a few more face shapes, as well as the ability to select (or remove) different ear styles.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Holiday Playlist[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new playlist from Lofi Girl featuring tunes for the winter season. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h2]2026[/h2][p]We have lots of plans for 2026! We can't share exact details yet, but we can let you know some things coming down the road.[/p][list][*][p][b]More free updates and DLCs coming throughout 2026[/b][/p][list][*][p]Expect more free updates as well as [i]at least[/i] one major paid DLC expansion pack.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Nintendo Switch Release (maybe)[/b][/p][list][*][p]We're working on it! This is something very new to us, so please be patient. We'll share more details when we can.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]As always, thank you for your support. We hope you look forward to these updates![/p][h3] [/h3][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/spiritcitylofi"]https://discord.gg/spiritcitylofi[/url][/p][p]Twitter/X: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FSpiritCityLofi"]@SpiritCityLofi[/url][/p][p]Bluesky: [url="https://bsky.app/profile/spiritcitylofi.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/spiritcitylofi.bsky.social[/url][/p][p]Youtube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@spiritcitylofi"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/spiritcitylofi/"]https://www.instagram.com/spiritcitylofi/[/url][/p][p]Merch: [url="https://mooncubegames-shop.fourthwall.com/"]https://mooncubegames-shop.fourthwall.com/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Music Partnership Update - part 2
notes.content:
[p]Hi Spiritographers,[/p][p]Keith here, the art director and one of the three co-founders of Mooncube Games.[/p][p]It's usually me writing these announcements, so I just wanted to introduce myself again and speak directly to our community.[/p][p]Our recent announcements about our partnership with Lofi Girl, and the replacement of the original music tracks, have sparked a lot of discussion. Some of you are excited, and some are understandably upset or confused. [/p][p]I’ve also seen some accusations and false assumptions being thrown around, that we are being deceptive, selling out, or acting in bad faith. That’s hard to read, because we’ve always operated with the community at the heart of what we do. I hope the trust we’ve built together isn’t so easily undone, and that our intentions continue to show through in the work we create and our interactions with you. If we've disappointed you recently, I'm truly sorry. I hope that you will allow us to prove to you in the future that we sincerely love and care about our community. We’re committed to showing you through our actions that we’re in this for the long haul.[/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]About the Homework Radio music in game[/b][/h3][p]First of all, I’m happy to announce that we have negotiated a new deal with Homework Radio. That means [b]we will no longer be removing any music from the game on August 25th[/b]. We have secured a new 3-year contract with Homework Radio, so for the time being the music is here to stay. [/p][p]We heard your feedback, loud and clear. We will also try to do a better job of highlighting the potential expiration of music licensing further in advance. [/p][p]For context, music licensing agreements are almost always limited in time. We originally had an exclusive contract with Homework Radio. This partnership helped us ship the game at a time when we had no clue it would do so well on Steam. While that contract was close to reaching its end, the opportunity to partner with Lofi Girl came forward. Rather than continuing with a short-term deal that would eventually expire, we thought that this was the best possible outcome and we chose to build a more stable foundation with music that can remain part of Spirit City for the long term. Unfortunately due to the timing of everything, we didn’t have time to announce this change far in advance.[/p][p]Homework Radio has been more than gracious in all this, and we’re grateful to continue to have their music in game.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Our Partnership with Lofi Girl[/b][/h3][p]Lofi Girl has been part of the inspiration behind Spirit City from the very beginning. We built the game while listening to their streams, and their focus on creativity and community has always resonated with us. We are super excited about this partnership! This is not about a large publisher stepping in and changing who we are. This is two companies with the same values partnering together[/p][p]Lofi Girl now owns shares of Mooncube Games. Us original three co-founders still own shares in the company as well. This isn’t about giving up independence. We’re still Mooncube Games, the small studio that created Spirit City, and we’ll continue making creative choices that reflect our values. What this partnership gives us is the security to keep doing this work in a sustainable way.[/p][p]We started Spirit City as a team of three, with help from a few amazing contractors. Today, we’ve grown to seven, and we’re proud of how far we’ve come. But there are some things we can’t do alone. With Lofi Girl’s support, we can grow our team safely and create new experiences both within Spirit City and in the Lofi Girl universe.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]A Message from Lofi Girl[/b][/h3][p]"To be completely transparent, the founders of Spirit City first reached out to us more than two years ago, even before the game launched. At the time, we didn’t feel ready to take the leap into the world of gaming. It’s only recently that we decided to truly commit to creating video games.[/p][p]Naturally, our choice turned to Mooncube Games. Their authentic, human approach and their vision for cozy gaming resonate deeply with the values we uphold at Lofi Girl.[/p][p]This partnership was born from a shared desire to build something beautiful together — not to take over or reinvent an existing franchise. Mooncube keeps full autonomy in their creative decisions and in the direction of the project. For us, that’s essential: we’re not here to impose anything, especially not on a world that’s already so coherent and so loved by its community.[/p][p]The goal is to bring to life a shared vision of gaming — gentle, immersive, comforting experiences — by combining our strengths while fully respecting the DNA of Spirit City and the indie spirit of Mooncube Games.[/p][p]What truly won us over, beyond the game itself, was the way the Mooncube team works: a small, human-scale structure, transparent communication with their community, a strong artistic sensibility, and above all, a deep respect for players. That’s exactly what we want to encourage in our adventure into gaming."[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Q: What is the status of the music in the game?[/b][/p][p][b]A: [/b]The Homework Radio tracks will be staying in the game. We currently have a 3 year contract with them, with the intention of renewal at the end. We will ensure that any changes on this front are communicated more clearly, and further in advance.[/p][p]We are also adding additional music from Lofi Girl to the game, any Lofi Girl music added will be permanent. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Are you still indie? What does the partnership with Lofi Girl mean for the studio?[/b][/p][p][b]A: [/b]Yes, we are still “indie”. Lofi Girl is a small, people-focused company themselves, not some big corporate machine. Their investment in Mooncube isn’t the case of a larger studio trying to assimilate us, it’s two companies with shared values working together.
We still have the same freedoms we had before, to choose the projects we want to work on. These days the term “indie” has been warped a bit. To us, and you may have your own definition which is fair, indie means:[/p][list][*][p]Explore our creativity without reporting every decision to a publisher[/p][/*][*][p]Take risks and try out new ideas[/p][/*][*][p]Work as a small, close-knit team[/p][/*][*][p]Stay true to our values and identity[/p][/*][*][p]Connect directly with our community and listen to player feedback[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Q: Will you add the ability to play custom music in-game?
A:[/b] We are exploring this possibility. It was not a priority before, but seeing how important it is to many of you, we have started looking into it. We cannot promise it yet, but we want you to know that it is on our radar.[/p][p]
Hopefully this will answer your questions and give you some reassurance.[/p][p]As always, thank you for your patience and understanding. If you have other questions or concerns that weren’t covered here, please let us know.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Music partnership update
notes.content:
[h2]UPDATE: As of August 19th this announcement is no longer current.
Please see our updated announcement here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2113850/view/670592606916314028?l=english"][/dynamiclink] [/h2][p][/p][p][b]🎵We have an important update to share with our community🎵[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Our partnership with Homework Radio will officially come to an end on August 25th, coinciding with the release of the [i]All Aboard![/i] DLC.[/p][p]It has been a true pleasure working with the Homework Radio team. Their calming, beautiful lofi music has been the heartbeat of Spirit City: Lofi Sessions since day one. We are incredibly grateful for their creativity, professionalism and support since we released last year. 🎶[/p][p]This means that the current Homework Radio music tracks and content will be replaced on August 25th[b]. [/b]We’ll be sharing updates about what’s next for the game’s soundtrack in the coming days. Check out our FAQ below for more details.[/p][p]If you want to keep listening to the Spirit City music curated by Homework Radio, you can find them here: Spotify: [/p][p][url="https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6ZV3dvtFWNmeP3QYnpr9b6?si=699ef35332c14a6b"]https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6ZV3dvtFWNmeP3QYnpr9b6?si=699ef35332c14a6b[/url][/p][p]Youtube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@HomeworkRadio"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Please support Homework Radio and their amazing artists by:[/p][p]Following them on social media: [url="https://www.getsl.ink/homeworkradio"]https://www.getsl.ink/homeworkradio[/url][/p][p]Subscribing to their YouTube channel: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@HomeworkRadio"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@HomeworkRadio"]
[/url]They’re doing incredible work  and deserve all the love. [/p][p][b]💗Thank you, Homework Radio and all the amazing music artists💗 [/b]For the vibes and for supporting us on this journey so far.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]FAQ: [/h3][p][b]Q: I really liked the existing music in-game, is there any way I can keep listening to it?[/b][/p][p]A: The music will be available to listen on Homework Radios Channels:
Spotify: [url="https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6ZV3dvtFWNmeP3QYnpr9b6?si=699ef35332c14a6b"]https://open.spotify.com/playlist/6ZV3dvtFWNmeP3QYnpr9b6?si=699ef35332c14a6b[/url][/p][p]Youtube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@HomeworkRadio"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: When will we know more about the new music?[/b][/p][p]A: We expect to post a Steam announcement about it in the coming days, and we’re very excited for this announcement to hit your news feed.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Q: Will there be as many songs and playlists as before?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes! We’ve worked extra hard to make sure we’ll still have the same number of playlists covering the same moods, and to offer the same amount of content for each playlist.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will the new music still be stream-friendly?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes! One of the key points of Spirit City: Lofi Sessions is for content creators to be able to use the in-game music while streaming, so this is very important for us to keep. As before though, the music coming from the in-game web browser cannot be guaranteed to be stream-friendly. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will the new music be AI-generated?[/b][/p][p][b]A: [/b]Absolutely not. That was never the case, we believe in the talent, creativity, and heart that only human artists can bring. All of our music and art is made by real people, and that will never change.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will there still be the web music browser in-game?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes, the web music browser might have a different landing page, but you’ll still be able to use it to listen to anything you want.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will my Streams/VODs from before the 25th be affected?[/b][/p][p][b]A: [/b]All previous music will stay stream-safe, so you can keep using it on your streams without any copyright issues.[b] [/b][/p][p][b]
[/b](Updated Aug 11th)[/p][p][b]Q: Will the new music arriving August 25th be a permanent addition to the game? [/b][/p][p][b]A:[/b] Yes! The new soundtrack will be a permanent part of the game for everyone to enjoy, always.[/p]

[/p][/*][*][p][b]5 All-New Spirit Companions[/b] - Meet new friends along each route! Including [b]Coorier[/b], a dutiful mail-carrying pigeon and [b]Aviotter,[/b] a jetpack-wearing otter who soars through the clouds

notes.title: Hotfix 1.9.1
notes.content:
Hello Spiritographers!

With the Spring update (1.9.0), we introduced a major change to the session timer with many new features. While many folks appreciated the improvements, it didn't quite resonate with everyone. It's important to us that Spirit City: Lofi Sessions remains as accessible as possible, so we've been carefully tracking your feedback and added some of the most requested features for the session timer.

Here are the full patch notes:

[list]
[*][b]Added an alternative circle view for the session timer, in the timer options menu[/b]
[*][b]Added an option to hide the countdown numbers in the timer options menu[/b]
[*]Adjusted the minute limit amount for the Session timer from 60 to 180
[*]Fixed an issue where the Session timer would sometimes add 15 seconds to a session segment
[*]Fixed an issue where the timer would sometimes badly convert remaining minutes when it is running
[*]Fixed an issue where the new Session timer can sometimes appear to be less wide than its default width, causing the interface to not fit inside of it
[*]Fixed an issue where the timer could not have :00 as seconds
[*]Adjusted the session timer so that long break can be set to 0 minutes, removing it from the session
[*]Added a setting to hide the clock UI altogether in the game settings menu
[*]Fixed texture artifacts in color customizable gaming chair
[*]Fixed an issue where the new Spiritdex hints weren't being shown in the "reached new spiritographer rank" pop-up
[*]Fixed an issue with some eyes disappearing on AMD Graphics cards and Steam Deck
[*]Fixed an issue with a certain Kitchen beam accent disappearing when selected
[/list]
Additionally, we hope you appreciate the MacOS version thus far! Here's a list of known issues for MacOS: 

[list]
[*]The Steam overlay appearing as glitchy on Apple Silicon chips, appears for achivements pop-ups as well. This is unfortunately not in our control and is on Steam's side to fix.
[*]A small number of players can have launch issues where the game says it's "Missing game files". For some, reinstalling the game should fix this issue, but it seems like there's more to do on our side to prevent this from happening. We are looking into it.
[*]The game's unfocused FPS settings are not being applied on Mac, resulting in a higher constant FPS usage. In the meantime, if you feel like the game is a lot to handle for your hardware, we recommend setting a lower FPS setting or lowering the screen resolution scale for now.
[/list] 

Thank you for your support, and have a great productive week!

notes.title: Spring Update and MacOS support now available! 🌸
notes.content:
Hello Spiritographers! 

Today is the release of our Spring Update, bringing our game to version 1.9 🌸

[b]Get ready for a brand new spirit to discover, new music, new customizable items for the bedroom, a reworked session timer, and more![/b] ✅

You can find the full patch notes below:

[h2][b]New Content:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] New Spring-themed background inspired by cherry blossom season in Japan.
[*] A new Spirit to discover has arrived in time for Spring!
[*] 50+ room customization items added with the new color customization feature.
[*] 50 new Avatar items added with color customization
[*] 2 new cherry blossom headband hat items
[*] 2 new cherry blossom flower items added as accessories to room customization - also useable in the Kitchen DLC
[*] 2 Kitsune-themed skins for Twintail
[*] 22 Spring-themed cherry blossom skins have been added for all base game Spirits.
[*] 3 Spring-themed skins for Capybun, Bubble Ducky and Squire Sprout from the Kitchen DLC
[*] A brand new "Sweeping" activity is available at the bay window, perfect for Spring cleaning!
[*] A brand new playlist is available, with over 20 new songs to put you in the zone while you relax, work, or clean!
[/list]
[h2][b]Quality of Life Adjustments:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] A new "Save" tab has been added to the settings menu for players to easily locate their local saves and the automatic backups, in case!
[*] We've heard your confusion around selecting Cozy Kitchen Spirits Variants as companions.  While customizing your avatar, you will now see that Spirit Variants (from the Cozy Kitchen DLC) are now shown individually instead of being under their parent Spirit skins.
[*] While customizing the room, we have adjusted the camera for the "Scenery" category, under the "General" tab.
[*] We have adjusted the audio fading parameters to be extra quiet while the Session timer is ringing, to make extra sure that it's noticeable even while other sounds are playing!
[/list]
[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fully redesigned [b]Session Timer [/b] - Designed to be more intuitive, and give a better sense of how the work sessions are split. Additionally, you can now also use a [b]Stopwatch[/b] mode, and a [b]Timer[/b] mode for your sessions. There's also a Settings tab for the timer tools which will grow over time with multiple options to adjust!
[*] You can now revert back to an item's default color when using the new color customization tool.
[*] In avatar customization, head accessories, hair, eyebrows and facial hair can now use our new color customization tool! We will eventually expand this to eyes and skin tones as well.
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some playlists weren't saved properly and couldn't be set to play automatically on reload.
[*] Fixed an issue where the window controls would be visible even when the game is in Borderless fullscreen. They are now completely hidden but can be brought back by hovering the top part of the screen.
[/list]

[b][h2]MacOS Support[/h2][/b]

Spirit City is now available on MacOS! All features should be compatible, except the "Always on top" mode which is only compatible for Windows users. As we may find some new bugs specific to MacOS, please be patient for any issues that might arise while we collect data and patch issues.

MacOS and Windows saves are cross-compatible! If you're going to use the game on Windows and MacOS, make sure you update both devices at the same time so that they're on the same game version! Otherwise, it might create issues with save files. If you do get any issues regarding your save files, please check out the new "Saves" section in the settings menu. 

Our minimum requirements for Mac devices are quite high as this game is built using the latest version of Unreal Engine 5. You can expect any Macbook from 2020+ upwards to run the game just fine. Consider using the graphics options to tune performance that fits your hardware best. 
You can report any issues with MacOS on our dedicated [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2113850/discussions/2/]MacOS discussion forum[/url]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Updated Roadmap[/h2]
With the Spring Update, we've updated our 2025 Roadmap to reflect all the new features added.
It's not an exhaustive list, but it should give you a preview of our continued plans for Spirit City: Lofi Session!

notes.content:
Hello Spiritographers!
Spring is here, and as the flowers begin to bloom, we are hard at work on our next free update!

notes.title: Cozy Kitchen Expansion now available!
notes.content:
Hello [i]Spiritographers[/i], the wait is over!
[h1]The Cozy Kitchen Expansion for Spirit City: Lofi Sessions is now available! [/h1]

We put in a lot of hard work and we hope you enjoy all the content available in our first major DLC. 
We are incredibly grateful for all your continued support and are so happy we get to continue to support Spirit City: Lofi Sessions with both free updates and paid DLC.🥰

[b]Now, let's get into the details of the Cozy Kitchen expansion! [/b]

[previewyoutube=Xq7seVLX9PE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]What’s Cooking in the Cozy Kitchen Expansion?[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Three New Spirits to Befriend[/b] – New adorable Spirits to keep you company in the Kitchen - Including Capybun, a loaf-life capybara and Squire Sprout, a vegetable knight-in-training
[*] [b]Nine Discoverable Spirit Variants[/b] – Expand your Spiritdex with unique and rare versions of your favorite spirits - Including Bentobunny, a variant of Dustbunny who loves sleeping in packed lunches and Toast-mate, a retro toaster variant of APE-bit.
[*] [b]A Fully Customizable Kitchen[/b] – Personalize your dream kitchen with new decor options, including countertops, backsplashes, cabinets, and a cozy breakfast nook.

[i][b]*This feature will be expanded to the base game in a free future update, so stay tuned![/b][/i]
[*] [b]Expanded Spiritdex[/b] – A dedicated new Spiritdex page for your culinary-themed spirit friends.
[*] [b]New Avatar Items[/b] – Look the part as you don new aprons and chefs hats for your avatar.
[*] [b]New Kitchen Activities[/b] – Enjoy cozy kitchen tasks like chopping veggies, cooking and washing dishes to enhance your daily productivity and relaxation.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42923/Spirit_City_Lofi_Sessions__Allin_Bundle/

[hr][/hr]
Additionally, [b]we've also updated the base game with a bunch of cool stuff![/b] As we always say, any new features, QOL. or improvements will remain available to everyone for free, and will never be locked in a DLC. ✨

Notably, in this Update 1.8.0, check out the [b]new "Always on top" mode for the game window[/b], [b]new kitchen-themed soundscapes (for free!)[/b] and a [b]fresh new look for the Spiritdex[/b]. See full patch notes below for all the details!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]1.8.0 Update - Full patch notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] FEATURE: We've added an "Always on top" mode for the game, which locks the game window on top of everything else. You can use it from the button in the new game bar menu and from a rebindable shortcut as well! We hope this makes it easier to have Spirit City always with you on your monitor!
[*] FEATURE: We've added a loading screen, about time!
[*] FEATURE: We've added a "News" section so that you can check out all of Spirit City's latest right from the game application.
[*] CONTENT: We've updated the Spiritdex look with extra visuals for each existing Spirit!
[*] CONTENT: To add with the Cozy Kitchen DLC, we've added 3 new soundscapes: Kitchen Ambience, Tasty Bubbling and Dishwasher sounds. While they only are useful to discover new Spirits in the Cozy Kitchen DLC, those soundscapes are free for everyone to enjoy!
[*] CONTENT: New activities for some Spirits! Now way more Spirits can be reading, gaming and meditating alongside you.
[*] QOL: Added a new save file for pomodoro timer settings! Your work and break timer values will now be saved across sessions.
[*] QOL: Selecting a Spirit in the Avatar customization menu will now remember the last equipped skin for that Spirit.
[*] QOL: Adjusted the Avatar and Room customization menus to take less space in the screen, letting you visualize your changes better!
[*] QOL: Added navigation arrows in the Avatar,  Room customization, and Settings menus to offer an easier alternative way to select tabs
[*] QOL: Going into Room customization will now auto-select the tab at the current activity location.
[*] QOL: Added an additional graphics setting for fine-tuning shadows quality.
[*] ADJUSTMENT: The game window will now have subtle rounded corners for a more polished look on Windows computers.
[*] ADJUSTMENT: We removed the Discord Rich presence functionality from the game since it was creating some issues on Discord for users such as showing Spirit City being played twice, and added no value to the default's Discord preview.
[*] ADJUSTMENT: Moved the "Scenery" category to the "General" tab in Room customization.
[*] BUG: Fixed an issue where reordering to-do lists would sometimes merge the items inside of them.
[*] BUG: Fixed an issue where the game was crashing after level 500. (Yes, someone reached level 500! What an achievement!)
[*] BUG: Removed the delay before showing tasks, habits, and journal entries, which was causing issues for those with many entries.
[*] BUG: Fixed an issue where entering text in to-do tasks, habits, or journal would not render characters properly if they were from an unsupported language.
[*] BUG: Fixed an issue where moving in-game widgets around the screen was not always functional across different game window sizes.
[*] BUG: Fixed an issue with the frame rate settings where they wouldn't consistently be applied when the game launches.

[h1]Spirit Stitch Community Challenge! 🧶❄️ [/h1]

Whether you crochet, knit, stitch, or create plushies, this challenge is for YOU. Show us your handmade creations inspired by the world of Spirit City and you could win fantastic prizes! ✨

We want to see your interpretation of the world of Spirit City through the art of yarn crafts. You can create anything from a spirit, a character, a scene, or an object that fits the game. Get creative with crochet, knitting, plushies, or embroidery—anything made from yarn or thread! 🧶

[*]We welcome entries from professionals, hobbyists, enthusiasts and first starters!
[*]Entries can be made using yarn, thread, fabric, or similar materials. They could be a scarf, a desk toy, coasters, anything you like! You can use any technique you like such as crochet, knitting, embroidery, etc.

[*]Step 1: Create a yarn craft inspired by Spirit City: Lofi Sessions.

[list]
[*]By entering, participants agree that their submission may be shared on Mooncube Games' social media accounts and used for promotional purposes.

This should give everyone peace of mind that even in the case of an unfortunate data loss, there will always be local backups to restore to :) 

Cheers!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 has arrived!
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 has arrived! 
It's been 2 weeks since our launch, and the reception has simply been amazing. Thank you so much for all the positive reviews, it warms our hearts! 

NEW FEATURES
[list]
We're happy to introduce new graphics menu options that will certainly help players fine-tune their game experience for their needs.
[*] We added a distinct 'FPS cap' option for when the game is 'unfocused' which lets you automatically lower the FPS when you're busy doing something else (when you click away from the game window).
[*] We added a new 'Screen resolution scale' option to help fine-tune your graphics card usage. Setting it to a lower % will make the game a bit more blurry, but can drastically improve performance and temperature/fan noise on laptops.
[*] Generally the other graphic menu options should be more responsive.
[/list]
NEW CONTENT
[list]
[*] We added 2 new hairstyles, a 'Messy Bun Hairstyle' and a 'Short Ponytail Undercut Hairstyle'
[*] New Facial Hair options, and updated existing Facial Hair options
[*] New mugs for your desk accessory
[/list]

ADJUSTMENTS
[list]
[*] For the Steam Achievements that were unlocked while offline, these achievements will now retroactively unlock the next time the game is opened while Steam is online!
[*] We increased passive EXP earned per minute by 50%, to help people reach the level achievements a bit faster, while we think of more meaningful ways to gain EXP and Spirit Credits in the future.
[*] [strike]While in windowed mode, we removed the in-game button for 'minimize', 'maximize', and 'quit' in order to use the standard Windows buttons.[/strike] Due to popular demand, we already reverted back to the borderless WIndows button!
[*] We added an 'Exit game' confirmation window that can be triggered by pressing "Escape" or available trough the Settings menu.
[/list]

BUG FIXES
[list]
[*] Minimized potential scenarios where players could lose progression (often their Spiritographer level and Spirit Credits) after the game was closed forcefully.
[*] Reduced game loading time for some that had their game taking a while to boot-up and seemed stuck on a black screen.
[*] Writing in the Journal will now automatically scroll down as you keep writing more lines.
[*] Feet should no longer disappear at the Bed - Browsing activity.
[*] Removed floating geometry at the Bay Window - Reading activity.
[*] Fixed clipping issues with knee high socks at the Fireplace - Reading activity.
[*] Fixed clipping issues with knee high socks at the Bay Window - Reading activity
[*] Fixed twisted arm at the Bed - Relaxing activity.
[/list]

WHAT'S NEXT?
As promised, we'll keep delivering more content, features, and quality of life (QOL) upgrades throughout the year, We have a big content update planned for the end of May, so please look forward to it! 💗

notes.title: Dev Diary #00 : Introducing Mooncube Games
notes.content:
Hello wonderful friends!
Today we are starting a developer diary series for Spirit City: Lofi Sessions!
Our goal is to share some insights into the process of creating our game, the ideas and reasons behind our decisions, and to help our community understand us better!

First of all, we want to begin with introducing Mooncube Games, the studio behind Spirit City: Lofi Sessions.

[h3]Who is Mooncube Games?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43866816/9b52c99f3f2896e96fc77040ddf1f4c9c5e4544f.png[/img]
Mooncube games is a small indie studio based in Montreal, Quebec. We are three buddies who had worked together previously at other game studios, and finally decided to create a studio together based on our shared values.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43866816/2f628e1059779390f20b8b799adebb6447b92f87.jpg[/img]
That's us! From left to right

[b]Alex - Co-founder, Audio Director & Business guy -[/b]
Alex is the heart of our team at Mooncube Games. he juggles various roles, handling marketing, business, and audio direction. Outside of work, Alex is passionate about music, enjoys cooking, has a soft spot for Yoshi, and thrives on puzzle games. His dedication and lovely, wholesome personality fuels us on our gamedev journey.

[b]Felix - Co-founder, Designer & Programmer - [/b]
Felix is a multi-talented force in Mooncube Games. He wears the hats of design, programming and tech art. With a keen eye for detail and a passion for problem-solving, Felix ensures we stay organized and efficient. The perfect day for Felix would be chilling with a big plate of spaghetti, listening to the Sonic Adventure 2 soundtrack and working on Mooncube stuff.

[b]Keith - Co-founder & Art director - (That's me!) [/b]
I work as Art Director, 3D artist and writer. I spend my day bringing our game to life by designing, then modelling the world and characters. I'm passionate about creating a compelling unique world. As a child my dream was to become a Sailor Scout, but game development was a close second. You can usually find me listening to 90s dance music and playing jrpgs and farming games.

[h3]Our Values[/h3]

At Mooncube Games we want to create games that promote positive and uplifting experiences that align with our core values of kindness, empathy and inclusivity. We hope to do this by creating rich, unique worlds, with a diverse cast of memorable characters.

We believe that games have the power to be evoke emotions, inspire change, and be a safe space for players. These values fuel every decision we make as a company. 

Thank you for joining us on this journey, and we hope you enjoy these dev diaries! Let us know what you'd like to see next!
